user.title: AigoSmart account (unofficial integration)
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the AigoSmart app.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: AigoSmart asked for an email verification code. A code was sent to {email} — enter it below. Codes expire after a few minutes; tick "Send a new code" and submit to get another one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AigoSmart
reauth_confirm.description: The AigoSmart cloud refused the stored login for {email}. This happens when the password was changed or the server asks for a new email verification code. Enter the new password, or leave it blank to retry with the current one (a verification code will be emailed if needed).

reconfigure.title: Change AigoSmart account
reconfigure.description: Update the email or password used to log in. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Devices in pairing mode found via Bluetooth and WiFi. Put your device in pairing mode first (usually by holding its power button for 5 seconds).

wifi.title: WiFi credentials
wifi.description: Enter the WiFi network the new device should join. Provisioning happens over Bluetooth (works via ESPHome bluetooth proxy).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AigoSmart cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is wrong or expired. Check the email, or tick "Send a new code".
error.code_send_failed: The verification code email could not be requested. Tick "Send a new code" and submit to try again.
error.unknown_device: Selected device is no longer visible.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed. Make sure the device is still in pairing mode and near the Bluetooth adapter/proxy, then try again.

abort.not_loaded: The AigoSmart integration must be set up first.
abort.no_devices_found: No Aigostar devices in pairing mode were found. Hold the device's power button for ~5 seconds and try again.
